sections_breakdown.name: Behind Sadguru — Founder's Heart
sections_breakdown.title: Founder & Creative Director
sections_breakdown.story: Events are not merely scheduled dates with decor. In India, a wedding or a community gathering is a family's lifetime of pride, love, and sacred joy. I founded Sadguru Event Planner with one unshakeable conviction: when hosts step into their celebration, they must feel completely at peace — free to laugh, cry, and embrace their loved ones, knowing every unseen detail is safeguarded by people who care as much as family.

sections_breakdown.name: Philosophy — This Is Our Real Earning
sections_breakdown.body: When the lights dim, the final song fades, and a father holds our hand with tears of relief and joy — that hug is our greatest milestone. We don't measure success by square feet of trussing; we measure it by the heartbeats we made effortless.

items.title: People First
items.desc: Technology and decor are secondary to how human beings feel inside our spaces.

items.title: Details Matter
items.desc: From the warmth of the welcome drink to the exact cue of the bride's entry music.

items.title: Execution Is Everything
items.desc: A brilliant concept means nothing without flawless, punctual, and calm execution.

items.title: Emotion Over Everything
items.desc: Every visual, note of sound, and lighting transition is tuned to invoke genuine wonder.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind CSS fonts in frontend/src/index.css with @import '@fontsource-variable/playfair-display'; and @import '@fontsource-variable/manrope';
Ensure dark mode is active by default in frontend/index.html on <html> element.
Import Lucide icons for UI controls and SimpleIcons / Lucide for WhatsApp and Instagram.
In ContactWhatsAppForm, build a luxury multi-field inquiry form that assembles an elegant WhatsApp message and opens https://wa.me/919879500000?text=... with encoded parameters.
Implement the Case Study modal using Shadcn Dialog primitive or high-grade Framer Motion overlay with detailed responsibilities, key metrics, and high-resolution photo gallery.
Ensure every interactive button, link, and input has data-testid attributes like 'hero-explore-cta', 'nav-contact-btn', 'project-card-trusha-karan', 'modal-close-btn', 'contact-form-submit-btn'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie no app-wide `text-align: center` rule in the CSS entry.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
